productionCallers.need: Package-manager setup commands from language adapters, npm/pip/cargo and other manifests, followed by validation. Offline setup remains none. Any setup requesting a network is registry-only and now refuses before source dispatch.
Browser dependency installation uses registry-only. It cannot be truthfully verified online without restricted network infrastructure.
Interactive preview process policy also has separate preview/restricted semantics. Those modes are not certified as registry-only by this patch.
Direct execute and exec-command construction now refuse registry-only before any machine allocation. No live Fly test performed.
Direct execute refuses registry-only before HTTP. A health flag alone cannot attest destination filtering.

verification.offlineInstall: Synthetic local file dependency installed with npm --offline --ignore-scripts in actual existing ContainerSandboxRuntime using network none
verification.kernelEvidence: No non-loopback interfaces, no default IPv4 route. TCP probes to public, RFC1918, link-local/metadata and IPv6-private targets all denied.

remainingRequirement: An independently verified existing worker or transport must enforce registry allowlists at kernel/network boundary, including direct IP, DNS, IPv6, redirects, CONNECT and metadata bypasses, before online registry-only installs can be enabled. No operator boolean or arbitrary Docker bridge is accepted as that proof.

persistentRuntimeContinuation.manager: Registry-only exec and startProcess refuse before loading session or resolving secrets
persistentRuntimeContinuation.directFlyProvider: executableLine refuses registry-only before execRaw can send a command or process script
persistentRuntimeContinuation.includes: Project runtime, browser adapter, existing P0 and zero-effect direct execution negatives

persistentNativeReviewReconciliation.disposition: NOT_PERSISTENCE applies only to these built-in Buffer conversions. Provider/storage/authority obligations stay open. Entire containing methods are identical before and after the policy change.

nativeConversionReviewReconciliation.semanticEvidence: This one built-in Buffer conversion encodes synthetic/project bytes. It is not storage persistence. Its provider upload, environment, source ownership and all execution obligations are retained separately. No validator was changed.
